faq1Q: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan later?
faq1A: Yes! You can switch plans at any time and the change applies immediately. You're credited for the unused time on your old plan, and the difference is prorated on your next invoice — you never pay twice for the same period.
faq2Q: What happens when my free trial ends?
faq2A: When your trial ends, you'll be asked to choose a paid plan to continue using smart replies. Your connected pages, Post Replies, and settings are preserved — nothing is lost.
faq3Q: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
faq3A: Absolutely. You can cancel anytime from your account settings. Your plan stays active until the end of the current billing period.
faq4Q: What payment methods do you accept?
faq4A: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) through Stripe, our secure payment provider. If card payments aren't available in your region, contact us via WhatsApp and we'll arrange an alternative payment method.
faq5Q: What happens when I reach my smart reply limit?
faq5A: When you reach your monthly smart reply limit, Post Replies continue working normally. If you have a top-up balance, AI-powered smart replies also keep running — top-up replies never expire and are used automatically once your plan quota runs out. Without a top-up balance, smart replies pause until your limit resets at the start of the next billing cycle. You can add a top-up or upgrade anytime for more replies.
faq6Q: What are Post Replies, and do they count toward my limit?
faq6A: Post Replies are keyword-triggered replies you set up on specific posts — when a comment matches your keyword, the reply you configured is sent automatically. They're unlimited on every plan and never count toward your monthly smart reply limit.
faq7Q: Can Jawab24 answer questions about my online store's products?
faq7A: Yes — on the Business and Pro plans you can connect your Shopify, Salla, or Zid store. Jawab24 syncs your product catalog so smart replies can answer questions about your products directly from your store data.
faq8Q: Can I buy additional smart replies without upgrading my plan?
faq8A: Yes — you can add a smart reply top-up pack anytime from your dashboard, paid by card or arranged via WhatsApp. Top-up replies never expire: they sit in your balance and are used automatically only after your monthly plan quota runs out.
faq9Q: Are there extra Meta fees for WhatsApp?
faq9A: Replying to customers who message you is free — Meta charges nothing for replies within the 24-hour customer-service window, and Jawab24 never adds a markup. Meta only charges for business-initiated template messages (such as proactive notifications), billed directly to your own WhatsApp Business account — a type of message Jawab24 doesn't send today.
